reference.rubric: Each compliant distinct molecule scores 8×max(0,1-d/0.5)+2×IL classification probability, with d=max(6.5-pKa, pKa-7.5, 0). The total is multiplied by min(1, amine-local head-group signature count/5). At most 10 molecules, total score 100.

sources.locator: Module design rationale; not experimental validation of submissions

sources.verification_scope: AI checked fetched Google Patents Family Applications, Country Status, priority application and publication tables, and local family field; not an official exhaustive worldwide-family certificate; human review remains required

issues: There is no fixed experimental gold; scoring a real model answer requires actually running the pre-registered Linux reference model.
The QupKake free-molecule basic micro-pKa and the TNS-LNP apparent pKa must not be conflated.
The IL classification probability is neither a Tanimoto similarity nor an experimental transfection probability.
The source supports the design direction; forbidding or requiring a urea is a design constraint of this task and does not claim that the authors experimentally validated every new molecule.
Patent novelty, synthetic accessibility and actual biosafety are not evaluated.
reference.validation_scope: source-record alignment, scoring contract and payload checks; not an independent experimental replication
